effect: When a term is defined in a document another body owns, the glossary entry points at that definition and distinguishes the term from its neighbour instead of copying the owner's definition.

semantic.criterion: GLOSSARY.md gains an "## Inter-library loan" entry that links to docs/references/network-terms.md (the heading anchor may be included) as the place the term is defined. An entry with no link to the network terms fails.

The entry does not reproduce the network's definition: the clauses about the two librarians arranging it, the lending library's rules applying and the borrowing library being responsible until return do not appear in the glossary, verbatim or closely paraphrased. A short distinguishing phrase (a loan of a tool from another library in the network) is fine; the network's sentence copied in fails.

Read beside the Loan entry, the new entry tells a volunteer that an inter-library loan involves a tool held by another library in the network, not one issued from this library's own shelves, in at most two sentences.
The Booking, Loan and Overdue entries are unchanged in text, the new entry sits between Booking and Loan, and docs/references/network-terms.md is not edited.
The reply says where the result is, naming GLOSSARY.md.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
Whether write-for-humans was loaded for the prose, read off inspection.json (skillReads["write-for-humans"].body or .invoked true); recorded for the shared-reference question, never counts.

Whether docs/writing-guidance.md was read whole, read off inspection.json (sourceReads["docs/writing-guidance.md"].body true, through the skill-local copy or the canonical path); recorded, never counts.

Counts of reply sentences that are preface (sentences before the location line), contents (description of the saved entries' contents), offers (options or offers of further work), recital (an account of what was read, checked or done, other than the unresolved-meaning or remaining-inconsistency sentences the skill asks for) and assurance (claims about the result's quality or completeness), recorded in the note as preface/contents/offers/recital/assurance; pass when all five are 0. This is the suite's sentence rubric, not the cycle015 item rubric (which counts saved artifacts described, confirmed checks, named omissions, recovered incidents and extra-work offers over whole replies); the two are not interchangeable.
